description: Swapping the conditional operators for wildcard and testPrefix check in NodeNameTest, causing it to check for non-null prefix instead of null prefix.
Changing the NODE_TYPE_TEXT check for text nodes from || (OR) to && (AND), which is impossible for a single node type to satisfy simultaneously.
Accidentally checking NODE_TYPE_COMMENT instead of NODE_TYPE_PROCESSING_INSTRUCTION for the PI compiler type case.
Mutating the default return statement of the node type switch block from false to true.
Negating the equality check for Processing Instruction targets, meaning matching targets would return false and mismatches would return true.
